gloss: next fiscal year; next academic year

definitions.gloss: next fiscal year; next business or school year
definitions.explanation: The {年度|ねんど} after the current one — the business or academic year that begins next April in Japan, not simply the next calendar year.

examples.japanese: {来年度|らいねんど}の{計画|けいかく}を{立|た}てる。
examples.english: To make plans for next fiscal year.

examples.japanese: {来年度|らいねんど}から{新|あたら}しい{制度|せいど}が{始|はじ}まる。
examples.english: A new system starts next fiscal year.

examples.japanese: {来年度|らいねんど}の{予算案|よさんあん}が{国会|こっかい}で{審議|しんぎ}されている。
examples.english: Next year's budget proposal is being debated in the Diet.

notes:
Refers to the {年度|ねんど} (business or academic year) that begins next April in Japan, not simply the next calendar year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {来年度|らいねんど}の{予算|よさん}: next year's budget
- {来年度|らいねんど}{以降|いこう}: from next fiscal year onward

RELATED WORDS:
- {今年度|こんねんど}: this fiscal year
- {来年|らいねん}: next (calendar) year — different reading and scope
